items.item_text: Typing 20 wpm.
All testing must be completed by the end of the posting period.
Basic Computer skills to include Windows applications.
Must be able to reach, stoop, bend and do heavy lifting repeatedly.
Must be able to file alphabetically and numerically.
Knowledge of medical terminology and anatomy required, must pass Medical Terminology test.

Receives and directs, by phone or in person, visitors, patients, staff personnel and others, answers inquiries to include those concerning general organizations, facilities, and services, refers to others for further information or assistance as appropriate, and determines member and non-member identify and eligibility.

Creates master schedules and schedules patients for various appointments in Imaging Department utilizing current systems (OPAS, KPDS, RIS, etc.) on the telephone, by mail, and/or in person, by obtaining the pertinent information from doctor and patient, makes referral appointments as requested by doctor, calls patients with respect to appointment reminders and cancellations, notifies patients by telephone or mail of available appointment times and /or appointment changes due to cancellations or revisions of physician time schedules, confirms times, dates and patients prior to their scheduled appointments as required. Ensures that inpatient appointment instructions are delivered to appropriate wards.

Ensures that special instructions regarding all exams are understood by patients. (Scheduling Coordinators I must be knowledgeable of all preparations and functions of exam). Instructs and responds to members questions regarding the preparation and details of exams. Is knowledgeable of sedation procedures for various exams.
Interacts positively with patients, peers, physicians, and others, demonstrating appropriate levels of service.
Ensures that all scheduled ultrasound appointments are entered into PACs system daily.

Thoroughly reviews MRI and allergic reaction questionnaires for completeness and noteworthy cases to department RN or Radiologist prior to scheduling or performance of exam. Refers case to physician or department RN if contradictions appear to exist. Appropriately questions patients as necessary.

Prioritizes scheduling of exams as necessary, dependent upon clinical information provided (refers to established department guidelines). Ensures that all stat procedures are prioritized per physician request, including portable exams.
Determines and collects fees for copied films and Imaging Department exams.

Provides telephone reception by routing information and messages to other individuals and follows through providing general information making appointments and re-directing misdialed calls as appropriate.

Prepares and files or forwards lab slips for patients having special procedures, lab reports, appointment requisitions, processes consultations for cancellations and DNKs. Obtains patient charts, lab reports and other related material as requested.
Ensures that release forms are filled out by patients who wish their files to be sent to outside doctors and facilities. Initiates all necessary paperwork associated with patient check in.
Arranges for patient appointments at outside facilities.
Call back patients per MD request to have additional tests performed.
Ensure patient questionnaires for allergies/contradictions is completed before scheduling invasive procedures.
Serve as chaperone with female patients when male staff member is performing exam.
Connect interventional MD with other physicians.
Verifies patient identification and appropriately bands patients.
Assists in training and orientation of new personnel.
Prepares a variety of reports for Department Administrators and physicians as requested. Preparations to include typing, statistical compilations and copying where necessary.
Establishes and maintains courteous, cooperative relations with the public, patients, and other personnel.
Performs other related duties as required.

Promotes, ensures, and improved customer service to internal/external customers by demonstrating skills which are consistent with the organizations philosophy of providing extraordinary customer relations and quality service.
Schedule to include all shifts, rotating weekends, holidays, and floating within the established seniority section.
